CheckContrast.description: InformationalCheckContrast: separate from verified drift; insufficient proof for a verified finding.

Evidence.description: Native deterministic analyzer evidence. Free source-derived strings use consistent per-report opaque IDs by default. Structured identifiers and route metadata remain available; this is not raw source.

Finding.description: Verified deterministic drift only. Exploratory observations and informational contrasts are separate arrays.

url.description: HTTPS github.com/owner/repo; repository must be explicitly operator-allowlisted. Public repositories only; no credentials, ports, redirects or query.

Graph.description: Native ARG topology under a privacy projection. Peer groups, all inferred invariants, exploratory observations and informational contrasts are not exhaustively drawn. Duplicate edges may occur; see docs/arg-visualization.md for the exact semantics.

from.description: Existing node id in the same graph

to.description: Existing node id in the same graph

id.description: Graph-local presentation identity. Do not treat as a file path, URL or cross-analysis identity.

label.description: Untrusted display text under the API privacy policy; never HTML.

expires_at.description: Completed jobs expire; pending jobs have null expiry

Relationship.description: Indices reference report.routes; contract_eligible is independent of authorization evidence.

Report.description: Native analyzer JSON with a privacy projection only. Candidate relationships are not verified peers. review_observations are exploratory; check_comparisons are informational. Neither counts as a verified finding. Additive evidence fields may appear.

ReviewObservation.description: ExploratoryReview: separate from verified drift; insufficient proof for a verified finding.

path.description: Portable repository-relative Rust source, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock. No absolute/dot/hidden paths or links.

bearerAuth.description: Operator-managed ASCII secret of 32–256 characters. Do not embed in a public frontend bundle.

info.description: Single-tenant trusted-client API. Bearer access controls all analyses. Deterministic engine is authoritative; LLM integration is not enabled. Use TLS at a trusted reverse proxy outside loopback. All responses are no-store. Exact-origin CORS is operator configured. See docs/backend.md for limits and isolation boundaries.
info.title: ARCHER analysis API

post.description: Validate and enqueue source-only analysis. No submitted code is executed. No local server paths accepted. 202 Location identifies the job. Capacity/retention limits return 429; there is no unbounded queue.

delete.description: Delete a completed job and its retained output. Running jobs return 409; this endpoint does not cancel them.

get.description: Poll status. Missing, deleted and expired jobs return 404. Failure details are sanitized in error; HTTP 200 can represent a failed job.

Native ARG as a DOT attachment, not an image. IDs and labels follow the report privacy policy. JSON graph is available in the result report.graph; the Link response header points to that result. No arg.svg endpoint is provided. See docs/arg-visualization.md for the frontend handoff contract.

Link.description: Result JSON containing this graph's nodes and edges; exposed to configured CORS origins

get.description: Completed deterministic report. Pending or failed jobs return 409. Source files are never served.
Public readiness/configured capabilities; no credentials, source paths or allowlist disclosed.
This OpenAPI document. Import into standard Swagger tooling; no custom UI is hosted.
